## 16. CSS Selector Patterns

```css
/* Dashboard-scoped */
[data-dashboard="incident-report"] [data-component="card"] { ... }

/* Component-scoped */
[data-component="metric-card"] [data-part="value"] { ... }

/* Severity-colored */
[data-severity="error"] { border-left: 4px solid var(--color-error); }

/* Interactive */
[data-clickable="true"] { cursor: pointer; }

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  [data-component="data-table"] tr { display: block; }
}
```

---

## 17. R2 Additions (Content Specification)

- `data-part="timestamp"` — All 21 dashboards
- `data-part="target"` — MetricCards with thresholds (80% pass rate, <30m duration)
- `data-part="sample-warning"` — MetricCards when sample size < 30
- `data-dashboard="test-report"` — report-html.ts orchestrator
- `data-dashboard="pipeline-health"` — pipeline-health-renderer.ts
- `data-dashboard="weekly-quality-report"` — schedule-handler.ts
- `data-dashboard="quality-gate"` — interactive-mode.ts
